title: The online manual and navigation
steps: Open User Manual near the bottom of the scrollable sidebar. Its 13 chapters match this PDF.
Use the chapter rail and topic cards to browse, or press / to focus Search the manual.
The fixed bottom bar keeps Top and Bottom available while you read. They jump to either end of the page.
framing: Complete controls or form sections from the original browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Dark theme
steps: Select Dark Theme in the sidebar to use the dark palette.
Select Light Theme to return. The preference is remembered by this browser.
framing: Original 1351 by 1309 browser capture. Crop frames the documented controls; scroll in the application to continue the form.

title: Navigation on a phone
steps: Tap the menu button to open navigation. The close button, logo, and profile/sign-out block stay in place.
Scroll the menu between the fixed controls to reach other areas, including User Manual.
Choose an area, use Close navigation, tap outside the panel, or press Esc.

title: Preview role permissions
steps: Administrators can expand Preview access in the sidebar and select Editor or Reviewer.
Apply changes the menus and effective permissions. Return to Administrator ends the preview.
Preview actions affect application data. Use a separate sample environment when practicing.

title: Start the day on the Dashboard
steps: Scan the summary cards for work, booking inquiries, financial closeouts, and the purple Mail For Review indicator.
Work through My Work and promptly follow up on overdue items, then review upcoming engagements and incomplete details.
Review Needs Attention: the mail-review alert is purple and Financial Closeouts is gold. Select a record row or card to open it; separate controls keep their own actions.
note: Fictional task dates illustrate prompt follow-up: the oldest overdue example is five days late.
framing: Original 1351 by 1309 browser capture. Crop frames the documented controls; scroll in the application to continue the form.

title: Read and filter the booking board
steps: Search requests and narrow by owner, stage, or next action.
Open a card to review the request and its next step. The default view includes active inquiries and bookings from this month.
Archive Inquiry is available for declined requests and recorded bookings. Archived Inquiries opens retained records outside the current pipeline.
framing: Complete controls and sections framed from the original screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Review an inquiry
steps: Review the preferred and alternate dates, priority, owner, and next action.
Use Activity, Correspondence, and Tasks to switch the working panel.
Change stage as the request develops; a decline needs a reason and can be reopened.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Capture the request and date options
steps: Enter the request title and summary. Choose the organization and primary contact when known.
Record preferred dates, alternate dates, event type, and location.
Choose an owner, priority, source, next action, and due date, then save.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Give the inquiry a next action
steps: Keep the next action concrete, such as sending date options or requesting room details.
Set a due date so the pipeline and Dashboard can highlight it.
Use Source Detail for a referral, mailbox, form, or campaign reference.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Convert a qualified inquiry
steps: Review the proposed engagement and any schedule conflicts.
Choose the open inquiry tasks to move; clearing every box moves none.
Carry an unresolved next action forward as a task, or resolve it with a reason.
Acknowledge any availability warnings before confirming the conversion.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Write inquiry correspondence
steps: Choose Initial response, Request details, Date options, or Proposal follow-up.
Verify the primary contact, then edit the subject and plain-text message.
Queue the message when ready; its signed inquiry marker keeps replies connected.
note: The screenshot preview has mail delivery disabled. The form is shown without sending a message.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Archive a booked or declined inquiry
steps: Finish declining the request or booking and converting it to an engagement. Open the inquiry.
Select Archive Inquiry. Its details, history, correspondence, tasks, and engagement link are retained.
The inquiry leaves ordinary pipeline views. Archiving this source inquiry does not archive its engagement.
framing: Complete controls framed from the original screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Find and restore archived inquiries
steps: Choose Archived Inquiries from the pipeline or the archive panel on an inquiry.
Search retained Booked and Declined records. Export downloads the filtered archived view.
Open a title to read its retained information. Restore Inquiry returns it to its original stage; restore a declined inquiry before reopening it.
framing: Complete controls framed from the original screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Find an engagement
steps: Start with All lifecycle states, or select Active, Postponed, Canceled, or Completed. Your choice is remembered for your account in this browser.
Current and Archived are separate from Lifecycle. Clear both filters when looking for a missing record.
Sort by organization, date, confirmation, or lifecycle. Open the event title or View action to continue planning.
framing: Complete controls and sections framed from the original screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Use the engagement workspace
steps: Read the event summary and right-side readiness and next-action information.
Switch among Activity, Correspondence, Tasks, Presentations, Contacts, Logistics, and Financials.
Use the nearby routing-marker copy control when continuing a conversation in another email application.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Edit event details and schedule
steps: Choose an active organization and enter the event title and description.
Set valid start and end dates. Choose Other and describe the type when presets do not fit.
Assign a Caller for the initial checklist; later Caller changes do not transfer existing tasks.
Save Changes and Cancel remain visible in the bottom bar while you scroll. Save Changes saves the entire form, including presentation edits and pending file changes.
framing: Original 1351 by 1309 browser capture. Crop frames the documented controls; scroll in the application to continue the form.
note: The fixed bottom bar stays available as the longer form continues below the viewport.

title: Assign event-specific contact roles
steps: Open Contacts to see the people assigned to this event and their roles.
In Edit Engagement, add existing contacts or create new people. Assign Primary host, On-site contact, Billing, Travel, and Materials as applicable.
These roles are separate from a contact's organization affiliations.

title: Presentation details and audience resources
steps: Open Presentations and review the speaker, title, schedule, duration, and attendance. Use Edit Presentations to open the editing section.
Select View PDF Speaker Notes to open the notes, or Download PPT Slidedeck to save the PowerPoint for a compatible presentation app.
Select Copy link beneath a QR image to share its web address. Select the image to copy the QR graphic, or PNG/SVG to save it.
Combined Presentation Statistics covers all codes; Statistics beneath a code opens its own activity.
note: The first row of resource codes is shown. Scroll down to find the file and custom-resource codes.
framing: Original 1351 by 1309 browser capture. Crop frames the documented controls; scroll in the application to continue the form.

title: Share a PowerPoint download link
steps: Save a PPT Slidedeck to generate its presentation-specific code, then find the PPT Slidedeck card.
Use Copy link to paste its download URL into a message or document. The same control appears on the presentation edit page.
Use the QR image or PNG/SVG downloads in slides and handouts. Replacing the PowerPoint keeps these previously shared codes usable.
note: Copying a link or image does not add a visit. Opening the shared QR link records activity before delivering the file.
framing: Complete controls or form sections from the original browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Select and order QR codes for a PDF
steps: Expand Export Presentation and select View QR Codes PDF. Check one or more codes, or use Select all.
Drag any row by its handle, whether checked or unchecked. Only checked codes appear in the PDF, in list order from left to right and then top to bottom.
Keyboard users can focus a handle and use Up or Down to move a code. Select Prepare PDF to open the chosen sheet in a new tab, or Cancel to close the dialog.
note: PPT Slidedeck and Speaker Notes are selected and moved to the top. Other available codes remain below the visible rows.
framing: Complete controls or form sections from the original browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Edit presentation details
steps: Find the intended numbered presentation, check its topic and speaker, and enter the date, time, duration, and expected attendance.
Record actual attendance after the event. Zero is valid when nobody attended.
Continue to Presentation Files & QR Codes below these fields to add PDF notes and a PowerPoint file.
Use Save Changes in the persistent bottom bar to save the whole engagement form, including other edits on the page.
framing: Original 1351 by 1309 browser capture. Crop frames the documented controls; scroll in the application to continue the form.
note: The retained illustration shows the same presentation fields; the current view and editor also number each presentation section.

title: Upload or replace PDF notes and a PowerPoint
steps: In the intended numbered presentation, choose a file or drop one onto Drop PDF here or Drop PowerPoint here. PPT Slidedeck accepts .ppt and .pptx. Choosing or dropping a file does not save it.

PDF files may be up to 100 MB and PowerPoint files up to 500 MB. Save Changes uploads files in small chunks. Watch the progress indicator, keep the page open, and wait for saving to finish. Interrupted chunks retry automatically.
Use Replace PDF or Replace PPT to select an updated file. The pending notice remains until you select Save Changes in the persistent bottom bar, which saves the entire engagement form.
To stop sharing a file, select its Remove current checkbox, review Removal pending, then Save Changes. Choose replacement or removal, not both. The existing QR link and statistics are retained.
note: Only upload files intended for the audience: anyone with the relevant QR link can open the notes or download the PowerPoint without signing in. The retained illustration shows the file controls; the current editor also provides separate PDF and PowerPoint drop areas.
framing: Original browser capture framed around the PDF and PowerPoint controls. Current upload limits are stated in the numbered instructions below.

title: Save a pending presentation-file change
steps: Use Replace PDF or Replace PPT for a new file, or check Remove current PDF/PPT to remove the current one. Choose only one action for each file.
Read the pending notice. Selecting a file or checking Remove does not apply the change immediately.
Select Save Changes in the persistent bar at the bottom of the window. It saves the whole engagement form, including pending file changes.
After saving, verify the file details and sharing links. Leave without saving to keep the existing file.
note: Removal pending is illustrated with fictional speaker notes. The form was not saved and the file was kept.
framing: Original browser capture framed around the pending change and file controls; current upload limits are documented in the preceding walkthrough.

title: Review event logistics
steps: Open Logistics to review the event address, materials, travel, compensation, and lodging.
Planning estimates describe arrangements; actual received amounts belong in Financial Closeout.
Keep the physical event location accurate for the map and presentation exports.

title: Lifecycle and rescheduling
steps: Use Active, Postponed, Canceled, or Completed to describe the operational state.
Keep Work in Progress, Under Review, or Confirmed as the separate planning confidence.
Provide a cancellation reason. When rescheduling, link the replacement event from the same organization.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Review combined presentation QR activity
steps: Open Combined Presentation Statistics from the presentation pane. Totals combine its QR codes, including historical visits to disabled and previous-speaker codes.
Choose a UTC date range. Hover or tap the charts, or expand the data tables for exact daily, referrer, browser, country, and operating system counts.
Clear Filters stays within the presentation. Back to Presentation returns to its pane. A person opening multiple codes contributes multiple visits.
note: The chart uses fictional, seeded visit counts to illustrate the report.

title: Review financial closeout
steps: Open Financials to see whether a report is open, a draft, or final.
Use Financial Closeout to enter giving/income, lodging, and travel actually received.
A draft does not enter finalized organization financial history.

title: Draft and finalize received amounts
steps: Leave unknown draft amounts blank; enter zero only when nothing was received.
Resolve every task due on or before the last active presentation by marking it Completed. Canceled tasks still hold closeout.
Check the final-amount confirmation, then Finalize and close event when prerequisites are satisfied.
For a final report, use correction to update amounts while retaining the original close date.

title: Manage the email template library
steps: Open Email Templates under Work in the sidebar, or Manage Email Templates in an engagement email.
Search by name or subject. Select + New Email Template, a template name, or its Edit action.
Archive removes a template from new messages. Open Archived and choose Restore to use it again.
Only administrators can permanently delete an archived template after confirming access. Sent messages and history remain unchanged.
note: Fictional records from the isolated template preview; no email was queued during capture.

title: Add or edit reusable email text
steps: Enter a clear template name, a subject, and the starting plain-text message.
Use event fields such as {{event_name}} in the text. The engagement routing marker is added automatically when composing.
Existing templates can be edited too. Save Changes updates the template for future selections, leaving sent messages intact.
If another session changed the template, preserve your edits, reload, and review the current version before saving.
note: Fictional records from the isolated template preview; no email was queued during capture.

title: Personalize fields and suggest recipients
steps: Expand Personalize with event fields. Place the cursor in the subject or message, then select a field button.
Presentation schedule is available in the message only. Speaker names inserts text; it does not select recipients.
Choose suggested event contact roles. Leave all clear to choose contacts when composing. Lower Display order numbers appear first.
Save the template. Open an engagement email, choose it, and review the filled text and recipients before queuing.
note: Fictional records from the isolated template preview; no email was queued during capture.

title: Browse organizations
steps: Search by organization details or active contact information.
Review location, active contacts, last giving, and lifetime giving.
Use Active/Archived, sorting, and Records per page to manage a longer directory.

title: Review relationship history
steps: Use Activity for organization-level Chron.
Switch to Contacts, Engagements, Tasks, or Financials for related information.
Use Edit Organization to maintain details and add or move contacts.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Read organization financial history
steps: Open Financials for finalized giving, lodging, travel, and event reports.
Draft closeout amounts do not affect these totals.
Open an event report for the underlying figures and correction history.
note: Amounts are fictional examples.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Organization identity and addresses
steps: Only the organization name is required. Add affiliation, distinctives, contact channels, and notes when known.
Choose country before state or province. US and Canadian regions use dropdowns; other countries accept typed regions.
Use Same as Physical Address when mailing details match.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Browse contacts
steps: Search by person or organization, sort the list, and adjust Records per page.
Open a contact to review history and affiliations; the row action icons remain available.
Administrators can select aligned checkboxes and choose Delete selected. Select all applies only to this page; Clear selection starts over.
Review the selected names and related data, unlock if required, then confirm the Are you sure? dialog.

title: Read a contact record
steps: Check name, role, email, phone, photo, and organization links.
Keep person-specific conversations in this contact's Chron.
Create follow-up work here to retain the relationship context.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Maintain affiliations and a photo
steps: Enter names and contact channels; an organization is optional.
Set the primary organization role and add additional organization affiliations with their own roles.
Use Other with Describe Other Role for a custom title.
Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo up to 5 MB and save. Create Organization preserves the contact draft.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Find a saved speaker
steps: Search by name, email, or phone; use Name to reverse alphabetical order.
Open a profile, or use New Speaker to create one. Editors and administrators can maintain speaker details.
Administrators can use the individual Delete icon or select multiple speakers and choose Delete selected.
Referenced speakers are protected; only unused profiles can be permanently deleted.

title: Review a selection with protected records
steps: Review every selected name and the permanent effects before continuing.
A Kept notice explains why a referenced speaker is protected. The Delete button counts only eligible records.
Complete Admin Unlock when requested, then confirm the Are you sure? dialog. Cancel abandons this review without deleting.
After deletion, read the deleted and failed counts. Some eligible records may succeed while protected or failed records remain.
note: The fictional linked speaker is protected; no speaker was deleted during capture.
framing: Complete controls from an original CUA browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Speaker profile and resources
steps: Review the reusable speaker identity, biography, and audience links.
Open Statistics to review activity across the speaker's presentations.
Edit the profile to maintain shared details. The written biography and Bio URL serve different purposes.

title: Edit standard and custom resource links
steps: Add full web addresses for audience resources.
Choose Add Custom Link, provide its name and URL, and save the speaker.
New links receive separate codes on existing and future presentations.
Removing or renaming a profile link preserves already-published codes. Manage an individual code in Statistics.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Work the queue
steps: Choose My work, Everyone’s work, or Unassigned work, then a due-date/status filter.
Read the date and its timing label: overdue, Due today, Due tomorrow, or Upcoming. Dates use the application time zone.
Select the task to edit it, or the green check-mark to review completion. Archive preserves its status and details; use Archived to restore it.
framing: Complete controls or form sections from the original browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.
note: This fictional task is due the day after capture. Due tomorrow is separate from its High Priority and In progress labels.

title: Edit a task
steps: Write a concrete title and notes.
Search at least three characters and select the intended related record, or use general work.
Set assignee, due date, priority, and status. Waiting work should name the person or decision it needs.
Save task to persist the change.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Duplicate a task to another event
steps: Choose Duplicate to Another Event from the task editor.
Search events and select a destination different from the source event.
Review copied title and notes, ownership, due date, priority, and status before saving.
The original task remains unchanged.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Manage reusable event checklists
steps: Editors and administrators open Work Queue → Standard Event Tasks to maintain the shared starting checklist.
Edit a definition’s content, priority, display order, or due-date rule. Use + New Standard Task for another recurring item.
Archive a definition in Active to stop automatic creation for future events. Restore it from Archived to include it again. These changes apply to everyone creating events.
Existing event copies remain separate: archive an unnecessary copy in Follow-Up Work or the Work Queue. The required financial closeout reminder stays fixed at one week after event end.
framing: Original 1351 by 1309 browser capture. Crop frames the documented controls; scroll in the application to continue the form.

title: Schedule a standard task for existing engagements
steps: Enter the reusable title and notes above the Scheduling section. Choose priority, date anchor, day offset, and display order.
Administrators can check Also add this task to all active, open engagements before Add standard task. Editors can maintain definitions but cannot use bulk generation.
This adds the task to unarchived engagements with an Active lifecycle and open financial closeout. Copies use the date rule and go to the active Caller, or to the administrator if none is assigned.
On a saved definition, administrators can use Add to Active, Open Engagements. Existing copies, including completed or canceled tasks, are kept without duplication.
note: The option is selected for illustration; the form was not submitted.

title: Add a Chron entry
steps: Use Add Chron Log Entry to record a decision without opening the complete edit form.
Include the context, outcome, and agreed next step.
Save the entry; its author and time appear in reverse chronological history.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Choose To, Cc, Bcc, and a self-copy
steps: Choose an active template or Custom message, then select assigned contacts and optional speakers. Changing templates preserves selected speakers.
Choose To, Cc, or Bcc on each selected recipient card. To and Cc addresses are visible to all recipients; Bcc addresses stay hidden.
Under Send yourself a copy, choose Cc me or Bcc me for your account email. Matching addresses receive one copy and must use the same recipient type.
Review the subject, message, and optional brief before Queue Email. Check Correspondence for the delivery result.
note: Fictional recipients demonstrate To, Cc, Bcc, and Bcc me. No email was queued during capture.

title: Review the message and brief
steps: Edit the plain-text message for the event.
Expand Preview Event Brief to inspect the optional share-safe information before including it.
The event marker is maintained for routing. A sent checklist email does not complete its related task automatically.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Review copied inbound email
steps: Open Inbox in the sidebar. Use Needs review, Pending, Processing, Failed, Processed, Rejected, or All to choose a queue.
Search by subject, sender, or message content. Change Order or use the queue pages when needed. Needs review starts oldest first.
On a wide screen, the message list is on the left, the reader is in the middle, and the filing panel is on the right.
Select a message to read it. Search messages stays visible at a consistent vertical position. On a phone, use Back to messages to return to the queue.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Read a message and choose its Chron Logs
steps: Read the sender, subject, and message. Expand Message details for recipients, sent time, and attachment names; open Routing details for matching reasons.
Review the reason in the right-hand filing panel. Choose the intended Contact, Organization, or Inquiry suggestions when available. Scroll down to search and select an active Engagement.
Check the selected Chron log count, then choose Save to Chron logs. Processed messages show Message status and Saved to Chron so you can review their destinations.

Find matches again checks routing after record corrections. Other actions contains Reject message. Administrators can expand Manage retained email below the reader to purge the retained source after confirmation.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Locate engagements
steps: Filter the date window, lifecycle, and confirmation state.
Select a pin for event context; use Fit visible pins after filtering.
Use the list views to find missing addresses, pending lookups, or unlocated records, then Edit location.

title: Confirm an event pin
steps: Check the written event address before changing a pin.
Zoom and click the map, drag the pin, or enter latitude and longitude.
Check the venue confirmation, then Save confirmed pin. Use automatic lookup clears an override.
A later address change requires checking the pin again.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Browse the month calendar
steps: Scroll inside the desktop calendar to browse consecutive weeks across months. Previous and Next show the complete adjacent month named relative to the heading; Today restores the current month from its first week.
Choose Events, My Tasks, All Tasks, Birthdays, or Everything.
Tasks need an active status and a due date to appear.
Click an event, task, or birthday to open its record. The rose Today cell is separate from event/task colors.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.
note: The retained illustration shows one month. The current desktop calendar also scrolls continuously, loading adjacent weeks and their items; the phone view remains a daily agenda.

title: Private calendar subscriptions
steps: Name each device or service, and choose Events, Presentations, My Active Work, All Active Work, and/or Birthdays (from Contacts).
Create the link, copy its private URL immediately, and add it in the calendar application as a subscribed calendar.
Treat the URL as an access credential for its selected content, including task information when work is selected.
Revoke one device link when no longer needed; purge revoked records separately.

title: Manage your personal profile
steps: Open My Profile from your name at the bottom of the sidebar. Update your name, phone, or optional picture.
Use JPEG, PNG, or WebP for a photo, then review the crop before saving. The maximum upload is 5 MB.
The recovery email is displayed here. Use the separate Change Recovery Email form to verify a new address.
Scroll to Notifications to choose Daily Digest delivery time and days, then select Save Changes.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Choose Daily Digest time and days
framing: Complete Notifications panel and Save Changes controls.
steps: Open My Profile and scroll to Notifications. Enable Daily work digest to receive the Dashboard summary by email.
Choose Delivery time in the displayed business timezone and select the days. Weekdays, Weekends, and Every day provide shortcuts.
Select Save Changes. Delivery starts at the selected time; the mail worker may send a few minutes later.
To change delivery settings later, return to My Profile. The email footer contains plain text; Dashboard and record links remain available in the message.

title: Manage account security
steps: Every account type must use 2FA. Accounts without it enroll at their next successful password login. Replace the authenticator from Account Security when needed.
Change your password with the current password and required factor.
Generate fresh recovery codes when needed; save them securely because each works once.
Administrator resets and password changes can invalidate other sessions.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Start authenticator replacement
steps: Confirm your password and, when replacing an enrolled factor, your current authentication code.
Scan the enrollment QR code in an authenticator or enter its setup key.
Enter the generated six-digit code to verify enrollment, then store the recovery codes.
note: Only the initial confirmation screen is illustrated. Enrollment secrets and recovery codes are intentionally absent.

title: Connect MOED and Mattermost
steps: When configured, generate a one-time linking code here and run /moed connect CODE in Mattermost.
Use /moed today, /moed tasks, and event search/show for private context.
Editors and administrators may link channels and review task, Chron, and email actions.
Unlink an account here to revoke its Mattermost command access.
note: The disposable preview is not connected to Mattermost. The chapter explains the configured plugin workflow; this screen shows its setup prerequisite.

title: Review users and access state
steps: Review the identity, account state, 2FA, contact details, and Daily Digest days on each card.
Use the lower action bar: Edit user and security controls are grouped separately from account access and deletion.
Amber Deactivate suspends an active account; red Delete user permanently removes an inactive or invited account after confirmation.
Only eligible accounts have deletion checkboxes. Individual Delete user remains available alongside Delete selected.
framing: Complete controls and sections framed from the original screenshot; decorative footer excluded.
note: Fictional accounts illustrate active and inactive states. No account was deactivated or deleted during capture.

title: Delete one inactive user
steps: Find the inactive or invited account and select its red Delete user button.
Unlock administrator actions if prompted. Check that you selected the intended account.
Type DELETE USER exactly and select Delete user, or press Enter in the phrase field. Cancel keeps the account.
note: The confirmation is illustrated without submitting the deletion.
framing: Complete controls from an original CUA browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Review several inactive users before deletion
steps: On Users, select eligible account checkboxes, or use Select all on this page, then Delete selected.
Review the account names. Active users and your own account are protected. The selection survives an unlock redirect and expires after 30 minutes.
Type DELETE USERS. Select Permanently delete or press Enter to open the final confirmation.
Cancel returns to the user list without deleting. Changing the list page or filters starts a new selection.
framing: Complete controls from an original CUA browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Confirm or cancel the batch
steps: The Are you sure? dialog appears after the review, including when you use Enter in the confirmation field.
Select Delete permanently only when ready. Cancel closes the dialog without deleting accounts.
Read the result counts on the user list. Deletion checks administrator access and the original unlock deadline again.
note: Enter was verified to open this dialog. The batch was canceled; no accounts were deleted.
framing: Complete controls from an original CUA browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Invite a new user
steps: Confirm administrator access, then choose a unique username, email address, and role.
Review the recipient and access level before sending the invitation.
The recipient creates their own password through the activation link. Configure digest preferences from the user editor afterward.
note: This form is shown without submitting an invitation.

title: Confirm administrator access
steps: Select Admin Unlock in the sidebar, or open a protected action. Users also provides its own unlock panel.
Enter your current administrator password and a fresh authenticator or unused recovery code.
Select Unlock Sensitive Actions to return to the requested page. The five-minute unlock applies only to this signed-in session.
framing: Complete controls or form sections from the original browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Inspect the audit trail
steps: Filter by category, search text, date range, and exact IP address.
Review actor, action, affected record, and local/UTC timestamps.
Individual audit records cannot be edited or removed through ordinary record controls.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Preview audit retention
steps: Open the retention panel and choose the number of days to keep.
Preview the UTC cutoff and affected count before pruning.
Fresh administrator confirmation, the exact PRUNE phrase, and the final in-app confirmation are required.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Export an encrypted backup with uploaded files
steps: Open Database. The encrypted snapshot includes application records, PDF notes, PowerPoint files, and uploaded portraits.
Enter your administrator password and a fresh factor. Choose and confirm a unique backup password of at least 16 characters, then Encrypt and Download Backup.
Keep the page open while the export runs. Check the success message, Last backup created, and browser Downloads for completion.
Keep the complete .dnrbackup file, its password, and the separate 2FA key securely backed up. Ask the deployment operator to restore records and files together.
note: The credential and download section is shown with empty fields. No backup was exported during capture.
framing: Complete controls or form sections from the original browser screenshot; decorative footer excluded.

title: Review mail ingestion health
steps: Open Operations from the Administration chapter and scroll to Mail Ingestion. The summary above covers task backlog and other queues.
Compare Last checked with Last imported: a successful check need not import a new message.
Ask the deployment operator to investigate failures, overdue checks, or historical mail awaiting review. Use Inbox for imported messages that need routing.
Scroll to Deployment State for migration readiness and the last recorded encrypted backup.
framing: Complete controls and sections framed from the original screenshot; decorative footer excluded.
note: Synthetic mailbox state illustrates an overdue check and one historical message awaiting review. No mailbox service is connected to this preview.

title: Find a specific manual topic
steps: Enter a phrase in Search the manual. Results show specific topic titles, their chapter, and an excerpt with matching words highlighted.
Select a result, or press Enter for the first match. The page jumps to that topic and opens matching troubleshooting entries.
Use Clear or press Esc in the search field to restore the full manual. Use your PDF reader’s Find command to search this guide.
framing: Complete search field and matching topic result from the original browser screenshot.

title: Copy or export a presentation brief
steps: In Presentations, expand Export Presentation at the bottom of the card.
Copy Text produces plain text; Copy MD produces Markdown. View PDF opens the branded presentation brief.
View QR Codes PDF opens a selection dialog. Choose and order the codes, then select Prepare PDF to view, save, or print the landscape sheet.
framing: Complete rows or form sections; adjacent partial content excluded.

title: Change an existing QR destination
steps: Review the specific code and its activity.
Edit Destination and save to redirect an already-published resource code without changing its image.
